references.text: The same context where the father-in-law persuades the Levite to stay and eat and drink together
Repetition of the same pattern where the father-in-law encourages strengthening the heart with food
Lot insisted on hospitality and got the angels to stay with him, a similar theme of hospitality
Abraham's servant was asked to stay overnight, a similar hospitality situation
Continuation of the story where the father-in-law again tries to get them to spend the night
The expression 'strengthen your heart' is used about eating food before a journey, same context
Bread strengthens man's heart, a similar expression about food that gives strength
